work.originalTitle: ピョ・ウンジ1st写真集 輪舞曲
work.summary: Rondo, the Japanese KADOKAWA photobook of Korean model/YouTuber 표은지 (Pyo Eunji), has separate print and electronic editions released 2023-08-10. The distinct all-other-photo companion 円舞曲 is catalogued as its own title.

edition.contentSummary: Japanese KADOKAWA print Rondo, release2023-08-10,128pages,ISBN9784048976268,A4; artist-store dimensions297×210×10mm retained. Hanmoto corroborates print bibliography and referenceJPY3300, but exact cover permission is unknown (書影利用可否不明). Maruzen Junkudo public product captured2026-10-25 displays tax-inclusiveJPY3300 with explicit no-stock/cannot-supply message; availabilityunknown, not purchasable stock. Existing artist-storeMYR97 members-only observation and remote images remain separately sourced. Separate Apple digital136pages/JPY3400 and alternate-photo Enbukyoku are not merged with this print edition. No new image URLs or reuse license asserted.
